The 4th house covers home, family, roots and your private inner foundation.

natal_jupiter_signs: With Jupiter in Aries, you tend to grow by taking initiative and trusting your own courage. Opportunities often come when you step forward first, and your enthusiasm can inspire others to try as well.

With Jupiter in Taurus, you tend to grow through patience, steady effort and appreciation of life's simple gifts. Good fortune often builds slowly and surely, and you may share comfort and abundance generously.
With Jupiter in Gemini, you tend to grow through learning, conversation and connecting with many kinds of people. Opportunities often arrive through words, networks and an open, curious mind.

With Jupiter in Cancer, you tend to grow through caring for others and building a warm sense of home. Your generosity often shows as nurturing, and blessings may come through family and close community.
With Jupiter in Leo, you tend to grow through creativity, self-expression and leading with heart. You are often generous and encouraging, and opportunities may open when you let your light be seen.

With Jupiter in Virgo, you tend to grow through useful work, skill-building and thoughtful service. Good fortune often comes from careful effort, and your helpfulness can make a real difference to others.

With Jupiter in Libra, you tend to grow through partnership, fairness and an appreciation of beauty. Opportunities often come through others, and your generosity shows in your wish to bring people together.

With Jupiter in Scorpio, you tend to grow through depth, honesty and a willingness to explore what lies beneath. Your generosity is often quiet but powerful, and shared resources may bring meaningful gains.
With Jupiter in Sagittarius, you tend to grow through travel, study and a broad search for meaning. Your optimism is often contagious, and opportunities may appear when you follow your curiosity.

With Jupiter in Capricorn, you tend to grow through responsibility, patience and long-term planning. Good fortune often rewards steady effort, and your generosity may show as practical support and wise guidance.
With Jupiter in Aquarius, you tend to grow through friendship, community and forward-looking ideas. Opportunities often come through groups and networks, and your generosity may serve a larger cause.
With Jupiter in Pisces, you tend to grow through compassion, imagination and inner reflection. Your kindness often flows freely, and a quiet faith in life may open unexpected doors.
natal_mars_signs: With Mars in Aries, you tend to act quickly and courageously, with plenty of energy for new challenges. In disagreements you are often direct and honest, and taking a breath first helps your strength stay constructive.

With Mars in Taurus, you tend to work steadily and persistently, building momentum that is hard to stop. You often prefer calm over conflict, and when you take a stand you hold it with quiet determination.

With Mars in Gemini, you tend to channel energy through ideas, words and several projects at once. In conflict you often reason things out with quick wit, and focusing on one goal at a time can amplify your results.

With Mars in Cancer, you tend to feel most driven when protecting the people and things you care about. You may approach conflict indirectly at first, and naming your feelings openly can make your actions feel lighter.
With Mars in Leo, you tend to pursue goals with heart, pride and a generous, creative energy. In conflict you often stand up boldly for what you believe, and your courage can encourage others too.

With Mars in Virgo, you tend to put energy into careful, skillful work and steady improvement. You often handle conflict by finding practical solutions, and allowing room for imperfection keeps your drive sustainable.

With Mars in Libra, you tend to act with consideration, often teaming up with others to get things done. You usually seek fair solutions in conflict, and trusting your own wishes helps you move forward with confidence.

With Mars in Scorpio, you tend to pursue goals with focus, stamina and quiet resolve. In conflict you often think strategically and feel deeply, and letting go of what is finished frees your energy for what matters.

With Mars in Sagittarius, you tend to be energized by adventure, ideals and the freedom to explore. You often handle conflict with frankness and humor, and a steady pace helps your enthusiasm carry you a long way.

With Mars in Capricorn, you tend to channel energy into disciplined, goal-oriented effort over the long run. You often meet conflict calmly and responsibly, and remembering to celebrate small wins keeps your motivation warm.

With Mars in Aquarius, you tend to act on principle and put energy into causes, teams and fresh ideas. In conflict you often step back to see the bigger picture, and sharing your feelings alongside your reasons builds understanding.

With Mars in Pisces, you tend to act on intuition and inspiration, often moving with the flow rather than against it. You may prefer gentle approaches to conflict, and clear, kind boundaries help you protect your energy.
natal_mercury_signs: With Mercury in Aries, you tend to think fast and speak plainly, getting straight to the point. You often learn best by doing, and a short pause before replying can help your sharp ideas land well.

With Mercury in Taurus, you tend to think things through carefully and reach practical, well-grounded conclusions. Once you understand something, you often remember it for a long time and explain it with calm clarity.

With Mercury in Gemini, you tend to have a quick, versatile mind that enjoys words, facts and lively exchange. You often juggle many ideas at once, and jotting them down may help you follow the best ones through.

With Mercury in Cancer, you tend to think with both mind and heart, remembering how things felt as well as what was said. You often communicate with care and may express yourself most easily in a safe, familiar setting.
With Mercury in Leo, you tend to speak with warmth, confidence and a flair for storytelling. You often think in big, creative strokes and inspire others when you share what you believe in.

With Mercury in Virgo, you tend to have a precise, analytical mind that enjoys sorting, improving and solving. You often communicate clearly and helpfully, and keeping the bigger picture in view helps your eye for detail stay relaxed.
With Mercury in Libra, you tend to weigh ideas carefully and consider every point of view before deciding. You often speak tactfully and are skilled at finding words that bring people together.

With Mercury in Scorpio, you tend to think deeply and keep exploring until you reach the heart of a matter. You often listen more than you speak, and your words can carry real insight when you choose to share them.

With Mercury in Sagittarius, you tend to think in big ideas and enjoy conversations about meaning, culture and possibility. You often speak frankly and with humor, and adding a few details can help your vision come across fully.
With Mercury in Capricorn, you tend to think in a structured, realistic way, focused on what works and what lasts. You often communicate with quiet authority and choose your words with care.

With Mercury in Aquarius, you tend to think independently and enjoy original, forward-looking ideas. You often notice patterns others overlook and communicate best when you have room to explore unusual angles.

With Mercury in Pisces, you tend to think in images, feelings and impressions rather than straight lines. You often understand what is left unsaid, and creative outlets can help you put your rich inner world into words.
natal_moon_signs: With the Moon in Aries, you tend to feel things quickly and honestly, and you often need room to act on your feelings right away. You find comfort in movement, fresh starts and a sense of independence. Being free to speak your mind helps you feel safe. Short bursts of activity followed by a moment of stillness may help your emotions settle naturally.

With the Moon in Taurus, you tend to need steadiness, comfort and a sense that things will hold. You find ease in familiar routines, good food, soft textures and time in nature. A calm home and reliable people help you feel deeply safe. Slowing down and tending to your body is often the quickest way back to your center.

With the Moon in Gemini, you tend to process feelings by talking, writing or thinking them through. You find comfort in conversation, variety and a little lightness when things feel heavy. Being heard and understood helps you feel safe. Naming what you feel, even simply, may help your busy mind rest.

With the Moon in Cancer, you tend to feel deeply and need a warm, protective place to belong. You find comfort at home, with family or chosen family, and in caring for the people you love. Feeling needed, and gently cared for in return, helps you feel safe. Quiet time in your own nest often restores you when the world feels loud.

With the Moon in Leo, you tend to need warmth, appreciation and a chance to express what is in your heart. You find comfort in play, creativity and the affection of people who truly see you. Feeling valued and celebrated helps you feel safe. Doing something joyful just for yourself may lift your spirits when you feel low.

With the Moon in Virgo, you tend to find emotional calm through order, usefulness and small daily rituals. You find comfort in tidying, planning and helping in practical ways. Knowing what to expect and having a clear task helps you feel safe. Being as patient with yourself as you are with others can soften worry into steady care.

With the Moon in Libra, you tend to need harmony, kindness and a sense of partnership in your emotional life. You find comfort in beauty, pleasant company and gentle conversation. Fairness and mutual respect help you feel safe. Taking a moment to ask what you need, not only what keeps the peace, may bring a deeper ease.

With the Moon in Scorpio, you tend to feel with great depth and to need emotional honesty in your closest bonds. You find comfort in privacy, trusted company and time to process feelings in your own way. Loyalty and openness from others help you feel safe. Letting feelings move through you rather than holding them tightly may bring a quiet sense of renewal.

With the Moon in Sagittarius, you tend to need space, freedom and a sense that life still holds adventure. You find comfort in travel, learning, laughter and big conversations about meaning. Feeling trusted rather than hemmed in helps you feel safe. A walk outdoors or a change of scenery often clears your heart.

With the Moon in Capricorn, you tend to handle feelings with care and to find steadiness in structure and purpose. You find comfort in getting things done, keeping your word and seeing progress over time. Reliable people and clear plans help you feel safe. Allowing yourself to lean on others now and then can be a quiet strength, not a weakness.

With the Moon in Aquarius, you tend to need room to be yourself and a little distance to understand your feelings. You find comfort in friendship, shared ideals and time to think things over. Being accepted without pressure to fit in helps you feel safe. Gently letting others into your inner world may bring a warm kind of freedom.

With the Moon in Pisces, you tend to absorb the moods around you and to feel with a soft, open heart. You find comfort in music, water, art, dreams and quiet moments alone. Gentle, understanding company helps you feel safe. Regular time to rest and recharge may help you stay tender without feeling overwhelmed.

natal_rising_signs: With Aries rising, you often come across as direct, lively and ready to act. You tend to approach new situations with courage, jumping in and learning as you go. Your outward style is energetic and straightforward, and people may sense your enthusiasm right away. Others often see you as someone who gets things started.

With Taurus rising, you often come across as calm, warm and pleasantly grounded. You tend to approach new situations at your own pace, taking time to feel them out before you commit. Your outward style leans toward comfort, quality and natural beauty. Others often find your steady presence reassuring.

With Gemini rising, you often come across as bright, friendly and quick to engage. You tend to approach new situations with curiosity, asking questions and making connections. Your outward style is lively, expressive and youthful at any age. Others may find you easy to talk to and full of interesting ideas.

With Cancer rising, you often come across as gentle, caring and quietly perceptive. You tend to approach new situations with a little caution, sensing the mood before you open up. Your outward style is soft and welcoming, with a protective warmth. Others often feel looked after in your company.

With Leo rising, you often come across as warm, confident and naturally expressive. You tend to approach new situations with heart, bringing generosity and a touch of flair. Your outward style tends to be memorable, with a love of color and presence. Others may be drawn to your sunny, encouraging energy.

With Virgo rising, you often come across as thoughtful, composed and quietly capable. You tend to approach new situations by observing first, then finding where you can be useful. Your outward style is neat, modest and attentive to detail. Others often see you as dependable and sincere.

With Libra rising, you often come across as gracious, charming and easy to be around. You tend to approach new situations diplomatically, looking for balance and common ground. Your outward style leans toward elegance and harmony. Others often appreciate your fairness and your gift for making people feel welcome.

With Scorpio rising, you often come across as calm, intense and a little mysterious. You tend to approach new situations carefully, reading what lies beneath the surface before you reveal much. Your outward style carries a quiet magnetism and focus. Others may sense your depth even before they know you well.

With Sagittarius rising, you often come across as open, cheerful and full of spirit. You tend to approach new situations as adventures, eager to explore and learn. Your outward style is relaxed, candid and often humorous. Others may see you as an optimist who widens their horizons.

With Capricorn rising, you often come across as composed, capable and quietly serious. You tend to approach new situations with a plan, taking responsibility and building trust over time. Your outward style is classic, polished and understated. Others often see you as mature and reliable, and your warmth shows more as they get to know you.

With Aquarius rising, you often come across as friendly, original and a little unexpected. You tend to approach new situations with an open mind, ready to question how things are usually done. Your outward style is individual and may break from convention. Others often see you as fair-minded and refreshingly different.

With Pisces rising, you often come across as gentle, dreamy and kind. You tend to approach new situations intuitively, sensing the atmosphere and flowing with it. Your outward style is soft, artistic and adaptable. Others often feel understood and at ease around you.
natal_saturn_signs: With Saturn in Aries, you tend to learn patience in how you assert yourself and begin new things. Over time, you may master a calm, steady kind of courage that others can rely on.
With Saturn in Taurus, you tend to learn lessons around security, money and what truly holds value. With patient effort, you often build lasting stability and a deep sense of self-worth.

With Saturn in Gemini, you tend to take learning and communication seriously, sometimes doubting your voice at first. Over time, you may develop a clear, thoughtful way of speaking that carries real weight.
With Saturn in Cancer, you tend to learn how to care for your own feelings and build emotional safety from within. With time, you often become a dependable source of support for the people you love.

With Saturn in Leo, you tend to learn to express yourself with confidence, even if it feels hesitant at first. Through steady practice, you may develop a mature, generous creativity and genuine self-assurance.
With Saturn in Virgo, you tend to learn the value of careful habits, sound skills and realistic standards. Over time, you often master your craft while learning to be kind to yourself along the way.

With Saturn in Libra, you tend to take relationships and fairness seriously, learning what balanced commitment truly means. With time, you may build partnerships founded on respect and shared responsibility.
With Saturn in Scorpio, you tend to learn about trust, emotional honesty and handling shared resources wisely. Over time, you often develop remarkable inner strength and resilience.

With Saturn in Sagittarius, you tend to approach beliefs and big ideas thoughtfully, testing them against real experience. Over time, you may grow into a grounded wisdom that others turn to for guidance.

With Saturn in Capricorn, you tend to feel at home with responsibility, structure and long-term goals. Through steady effort, you often build lasting achievements, and learning to rest is part of your mastery.
With Saturn in Aquarius, you tend to learn how to balance individuality with belonging to a group. Over time, you may help shape fair, lasting structures that serve your community.
With Saturn in Pisces, you tend to learn how to give form to dreams, intuition and compassion. With patience, you often turn sensitivity into a quiet, grounded strength that supports others.
natal_sun_signs: With the Sun in Aries, you tend to meet life head-on, with fresh courage and a natural instinct to begin. Your strengths are honesty, initiative and the energy to set a stalled situation in motion. You often feel most alive when there is something new to try or someone to champion. A gentle growth edge is pausing for a breath before you leap, so your fire has time to find its best direction.

With the Sun in Taurus, you tend to build your life slowly and surely, valuing what is real, lasting and pleasing to the senses. Your strengths are patience, loyalty and a calm presence that steadies the people around you. You often bring beauty and comfort into ordinary days. A kind growth edge is welcoming change as a friend, trusting that you can stay grounded even while things shift.

With the Sun in Gemini, you tend to move through life with curiosity, quick wit and a love of conversation. Your strengths are adaptability, a light touch and a talent for connecting ideas and people. You often learn best by asking questions and trying many paths. A gentle growth edge is choosing a few threads to follow deeply, so your bright mind can turn interest into lasting skill.

With the Sun in Cancer, you tend to lead with the heart, caring deeply for the people and places you call home. Your strengths are intuition, loyalty and a protective warmth that helps others feel safe. You often remember the small details that show someone they matter. A kind growth edge is offering yourself the same tenderness you give so freely, and letting others care for you in return.

With the Sun in Leo, you tend to shine with warmth, generosity and a heartfelt wish to create and express. Your strengths are confidence, loyalty and an ability to bring joy and courage into any room. You often feel most like yourself when your work and play come straight from the heart. A gentle growth edge is remembering that your worth does not depend on applause, so you can glow just as brightly in quiet moments.

With the Sun in Virgo, you tend to notice what others miss and to find meaning in making things work well. Your strengths are care, skill and a quiet dedication to being useful. You often show love through practical help and thoughtful attention to detail. A kind growth edge is softening the inner critic, trusting that good enough is often truly good and that you are already enough.

With the Sun in Libra, you tend to seek harmony, fairness and beauty in everything you touch. Your strengths are diplomacy, grace and a gift for seeing more than one side of a story. You often bring people together and help them find common ground. A gentle growth edge is voicing your own preferences clearly, knowing that honest wishes make a relationship more balanced, not less.

With the Sun in Scorpio, you tend to live with depth, focus and a quiet intensity that looks beneath the surface. Your strengths are loyalty, emotional courage and the ability to renew yourself through life's turning points. You often prefer a few true bonds to many casual ones. A kind growth edge is letting trust grow step by step, so others can see a little more of your inner world.

With the Sun in Sagittarius, you tend to approach life as an adventure, always curious about what lies over the next horizon. Your strengths are optimism, honesty and a big-hearted search for meaning. You often inspire others with your humor and sense of possibility. A gentle growth edge is pairing your wide vision with follow-through, so your best ideas can take root and grow.

With the Sun in Capricorn, you tend to meet life with patience, responsibility and a clear sense of what you want to build. Your strengths are discipline, reliability and a dry humor that lightens hard work. You often grow wiser and more relaxed as the years go by. A kind growth edge is making room for rest and play, remembering that you are valued for who you are, not only for what you achieve.

With the Sun in Aquarius, you tend to think independently and care about ideas that could make life better for many people. Your strengths are originality, fairness and a friendly openness to all kinds of people. You often see possibilities before others do. A gentle growth edge is letting yourself be close as well as free, sharing your feelings as openly as you share your ideas.

With the Sun in Pisces, you tend to move through life with compassion, imagination and a deep sensitivity to the moods around you. Your strengths are kindness, creativity and an intuitive sense of what others are feeling. You often find meaning in art, music, nature or quiet reflection. A kind growth edge is setting gentle boundaries, so your generous heart stays rested and clear.
natal_venus_signs: With Venus in Aries, you tend to love with enthusiasm and honesty, and you often enjoy the spark of a new connection. Your taste leans toward the bold and spirited, and you value directness and a sense of shared adventure.

With Venus in Taurus, you tend to love in a steady, loyal and affectionate way, showing care through touch and thoughtful comfort. You often appreciate quality, natural beauty and simple pleasures that last.

With Venus in Gemini, you tend to fall for minds as much as hearts, and lively conversation keeps your affection bright. Your taste is playful and varied, and you value curiosity, humor and a little room to explore.

With Venus in Cancer, you tend to love tenderly and protectively, creating a sense of home for the people you care about. You often treasure keepsakes, family traditions and the comfort of emotional closeness.

With Venus in Leo, you tend to love warmly and generously, with a flair for romance and celebration. Your taste is expressive and heartfelt, and you value loyalty, admiration and joyful time together.

With Venus in Virgo, you tend to show love through attentive, practical care and small acts of service. Your taste is refined and understated, and you value sincerity, reliability and thoughtful effort.

With Venus in Libra, you tend to love gracefully and seek partnerships built on harmony and mutual respect. Your taste leans toward elegance and balance, and you value kindness, fairness and beauty in everyday life.

With Venus in Scorpio, you tend to love with depth, devotion and a wish for true emotional closeness. You often value trust above all, and your taste is drawn to what feels meaningful and quietly intense.

With Venus in Sagittarius, you tend to love freely and generously, enjoying shared adventures and a sense of growing together. Your taste is open and wide-ranging, and you value honesty, humor and freedom.

With Venus in Capricorn, you tend to love in a committed, steady way, showing care through reliability and long-term effort. Your taste is classic and enduring, and you value respect, loyalty and things built to last.

With Venus in Aquarius, you tend to love as a friend first, valuing independence and authentic connection. Your taste is original and a little unconventional, and you appreciate people who let you be fully yourself.
With Venus in Pisces, you tend to love with compassion, imagination and a gentle, romantic heart. Your taste is drawn to music, art and dreamy beauty, and you value kindness and a soulful connection.
nine_star_bodies: Custom links La Hầu with words and paperwork. Speak with care, read contracts closely, and keep the first and seventh lunar months calm.
Custom links Thổ Tú with home life and small frictions. Keep plans simple, tend to the household, and take the fourth and eighth lunar months at an easy pace.
Custom links Thủy Diệu with travel, talk and trade. A good year to learn and exchange; keep words gentle and plan trips with care in the fourth and eighth lunar months.
Custom links Thái Bạch with money flowing in and out. Keep a budget, think twice before lending large sums, and go slowly with spending in the fifth lunar month.
Custom counts Thái Dương as a bright star: work, recognition and help from others tend to come more easily. The sixth and tenth lunar months are said to shine most.
Custom links Vân Hớn with heat and quick tempers. Stay calm in disagreements, protect your rest, and go gently in the second and eighth lunar months.
Custom links Kế Đô with changes close to home. Stay in touch with family, plan ahead, and take the third and ninth lunar months slowly.
Custom counts Thái Âm as a gentle star: savings, plans and close ties tend to grow quietly. The ninth lunar month is said to be brightest; take the eleventh slowly.
Custom counts Mộc Đức as a warm, kindly star: harmony at home, study and steady progress. The tenth and twelfth lunar months are said to be the best.

onboarding_consent_privacy_body: Ortus Destiny works offline. Your name, birth date, time and place are stored only on this device, are left out of cloud backups, and are never sent to advertisers or analytics. Anonymous usage data is sent only if you turn it on.
onboarding_consent_privacy_note: Your birth data stays on this device and is never shared with advertisers. You can delete it at any time in Settings.
onboarding_consent_tips_body: Reminders of good days and content that suits your chart.
onboarding_coordinates_error: Latitude is −90 to 90 and longitude −180 to 180.
onboarding_coordinates_subtitle: Decimal degrees; south and west are negative.
onboarding_date_future: This date is still to come. Pick the day you were born.
onboarding_date_leap_note: {{p1}} {{p2}} has a leap month {{p3}}. If you only remember the lunar day, pick Lunar and say whether it was the leap month.
onboarding_disclaimer: For reflection and entertainment, not professional advice.
onboarding_erase_failed: Some of your old settings couldn't be erased. Try again before you begin.

onboarding_name_helper: Shown only in the app; a first name is enough.
onboarding_offset_error: Use a form like +7, −3 or +5:30, between −12 and +14.

onboarding_place_none: No match. Try a nearby city, or enter coordinates.
onboarding_place_note: Your birth place sets true solar time and the Rising sign. The right city or province is enough.
onboarding_review_history_note: From 1945 to 1975 northern and southern Vietnam at times used different time zones (UTC+7 and UTC+8). The app corrects for your birth place and year.
onboarding_review_no_time_body: Without a birth time the chart uses the day only, so true solar time isn't needed.
onboarding_review_solar_body: Clock time is corrected for the longitude of {{p1}} and the Sun's drift on {{p2}}. True solar time falls in the {{p3}}.
onboarding_save_failed: Couldn't save your profile on this device. Check free storage and try again.
onboarding_time_body: From your birth certificate or what your family remembers.
onboarding_time_unknown: I don't know my birth time

reading_bodies_career: You do well in roles where you can persuade, present or lead. Clear goals and room to act bring out your best; handing off the details saves your energy.
You shine where reliability and craft are valued. Progress may feel gradual, yet what you build tends to hold; marking small milestones keeps you motivated.
You thrive with variety, people and ideas in motion. Teaching, writing, design or networking suit you; a simple routine keeps the many threads together.
You are strong in research, care, strategy or anything that needs insight. You work best with focus and trust; voicing your ideas earlier helps them be heard.
reading_bodies_family: You are often the one who organises gatherings and gets things done at home. Sharing the load lets others show their care too.
Family ties matter to you and others lean on you. Setting gentle limits keeps you a source of support without wearing you out.
Home feels best when it is lively and open to friends. Regular shared meals or calls keep everyone close.
Your family bonds are quiet but strong. Small rituals and retelling family stories nourish them.
reading_bodies_love: You love with warmth and loyalty, yet keep much of it inside. Saying what you feel, even briefly, helps a partner meet that warmth.
You show love through reliability and small daily acts. You value commitment; making room for spontaneity keeps things fresh.
Connection starts in conversation for you, and shared interests keep it alive. Give the relationship quiet time as well as lively time.
You feel strongly and need trust before opening up. Once close, you are devoted; letting a partner in a little sooner eases misunderstandings.
reading_bodies_money: Income tends to follow your name and initiative. Spending can be just as quick, so a simple saving rule protects what you earn.
You are patient with money and good at keeping it. Steady saving suits you; reviewing your plans once a year keeps them working for you.
Opportunities often come through people you know. Several small streams suit you; tracking them in one place keeps the picture clear.
You are careful and think about security for the long run. Trust your research; a small, planned budget for enjoyment keeps the balance.
reading_bodies_personality: You tend to say what you think and act on it quickly. People often look to you when a decision needs making; a pause before speaking lets that strength land gently.
You prefer to think things through and keep your word. Others find you reassuring; letting yourself change course now and then keeps that steadiness from turning stiff.
You learn fast and enjoy meeting new people and ideas. Your energy opens doors; choosing a few things to finish helps that curiosity bear fruit.
You notice what others miss and feel things fully. Quiet time restores you; sharing a little of your inner world helps people understand you.
reading_bodies_wellbeing: Your energy runs high and needs an outlet. Movement, sport or time outdoors helps you reset; rest counts as much as action.
Regular sleep, meals and routines keep you grounded. When life gets busy, protect one small habit that is just for you.
Variety and fresh air lift your mood. Short breaks, a walk or a talk with a friend help you clear your head.
You absorb a lot from the people around you. Quiet time, journaling or music give that pressure somewhere to go.

reading_wealth_by_strength: Money tends to come more easily with support around you. Partners, a steady salary and simple systems help you hold on to what you earn.
You do well building wealth step by step. Teaming up, learning before you invest and keeping a buffer let opportunities grow at your pace.
You can handle both earning and keeping. Balance effort with rest and let a clear plan guide the bigger choices.
You have the energy to go after opportunities and carry responsibility. Giving that drive a clear goal turns effort into lasting results.
You have plenty of drive and confidence. Channelling it into a project, a team or a cause you care about keeps money working for you rather than slipping away.

strength_bodies: Most of your chart pulls energy away from your day master. You do best with steady support around you: people, routines and rest that refill you before you give more.
Your chart leans toward giving out more than it takes in. Pace yourself, pick fewer battles, and let help in when it is offered.
Your chart holds its own and its outflow in good balance. You can adapt to most seasons; the main task is to keep that balance rather than tip it.
Your day master stands on firm ground. You have energy to spare, and you feel best when it has somewhere useful to go: work, craft, people to look after.
Your chart is full of your own element and what feeds it. Strength is plenty; the work is to channel it, share the lead and stay open to other views.
strength_footnote: Weighed the classic way: each stem, each branch through its hidden stems, the month branch counting most. Schools differ on the finer points, so read this as a tendency.

tai_sui_bodies: The year's branch is your own (năm tuổi). Custom says to move steadily: finish what you start, check details twice, and save big gambles for another year.
The year's branch sits opposite yours (xung Thái Tuế). Change is likely, in moving, work or ties. Plan ahead and it can be a fresh start.
The year's branch rubs against yours (hình Thái Tuế). Small disputes and paperwork need patience; keep agreements in writing.
The year's branch quietly crosses yours (hại Thái Tuế). Misunderstandings come easily; say things plainly and keep good company.
The year's branch loosens yours (phá Thái Tuế). Plans may need adjusting along the way; leave some room in schedules and budgets.
The year's branch has no clash with yours. Custom sees no special caution this year.
tam_tai_none: You are not in a Tam Tai run this year.
tam_tai_years: First of your three Tam Tai years. By custom, a time to slow down, avoid rushed big decisions and look after what you already have.
Second of your three Tam Tai years. Keep steady routines, take care on the road and with health, and go easy on large risks.
Last of your three Tam Tai years. The run is ending; tie up loose ends and prepare calmly for the next cycle.

{{p1}} meets you as {{p2}}. A practical day for tidy decisions and small, steady gains.
{{p1}} arrives as {{p2}}. Expectations feel firmer, and a clear plan turns pressure into progress.

year_theme_bodies: The year mirrors your own element. Confidence and independence grow; friends and peers matter more. Keep money and commitments clear when working with others.
The year brings people who want what you want. Teamwork can carry you far, while joint money and quick deals deserve a second look.
The year lets your talents flow. A good time for learning a craft, enjoying life and creating; keep an eye on comfort turning into drift.
The year pushes you to express yourself and question old rules. Great for new ideas and performance; choose words with care around authority.
The year opens doors to unexpected income, trade and travel. Chances come quickly; take them with a plan rather than on impulse.
The year rewards patient, honest work. Income grows step by step, and it is a good time to set your budget and home in order.
The year asks a lot and moves fast. Challenges sharpen you; protect your rest and health, and pick which pressures are worth taking on.
The year highlights responsibility and reputation. Promotion, contracts and formal ties are favoured when you keep to the rules.
The year turns you toward unusual knowledge, spirituality and solitude. Good for research and inner work; stay connected to people around you.
The year brings help from elders, teachers and paperwork that goes your way. Study, certificates and care for family are favoured.

ziwei_star_natures: The emperor star of the chart, carrying dignity, steadiness and a natural sense of responsibility. It gives you presence, the wish to lead with integrity and the ability to bring order where others feel scattered. Its gift grows warmest when you lead by listening.

A star of the quick, planning mind, always weighing options and seeing how things connect. It gives you curiosity, strategy and a gift for adapting when circumstances shift. Its growth edge is choosing a path and letting it ripen.

The sun of the chart, radiant, generous and outward-looking. It gives you warmth, visibility and the urge to share what you have with others. Its gift shines most when you also keep some light for yourself.

A star of metal and resolve, linked with money, skill and decisive action. It gives you discipline, practical judgement and the strength to see hard work through. Softening its edge with warmth lets its loyalty show.

A star of ease, gentleness and childlike contentment. It gives you a kind heart, a talent for enjoying life and the ability to calm those around you. Its quiet growth comes from adding a little steady effort to its natural grace.

A star of principle and intensity, holding both firm standards and deep feeling. It gives you integrity, focus and a magnetic seriousness about what matters. Its gift ripens when firmness is balanced with flexibility.

The treasury star, steady, generous and good at keeping things safe. It gives you patience, prudence and a talent for managing both resources and people. Its gift is security; its growth edge is welcoming change when it comes.

The moon of the chart, gentle, reflective and quietly abundant. It gives you sensitivity, refinement and a natural gift for saving and nurturing. Its light grows when you trust your inner feelings and let them be seen.

A star of desire, charm and many talents, drawn to beauty, pleasure and new experience. It gives you social ease, versatility and a lively appetite for learning. Its gift deepens when its many interests are gathered toward one purpose.

A star of speech, questions and careful scrutiny. It gives you a sharp mind, persuasive words and the courage to look beneath the surface. Its gift shines when honesty is offered with tact and warmth.

A star of the fair minister, who serves, mediates and protects. It gives you a sense of justice, good manners and a willingness to help others look their best. Its growth edge is caring for your own needs as faithfully as for others'.

A star of shelter and mentoring, like an elder who watches over others. It gives you wisdom, compassion and a calm hand in difficult moments. Its gift is protection; its growth edge is letting others learn in their own way.
A star of courage and drive, a general who rides ahead of the troops. It gives you independence, boldness and the energy to open new ground. Its gift deepens when bold moves are paired with patience.

A star of breaking and renewing, clearing the old so that something new can grow. It gives you originality, daring and the courage to start again. Its gift is transformation; its growth edge is finishing what you begin.
ziwei_stars_in_career: You tend to thrive in roles with authority, responsibility and visible standing. Leadership comes naturally, and inclusive decision-making strengthens your reputation.
You may excel in planning, strategy, analysis or advisory roles. Change at work is common for you, and following one long-term thread helps your career build steadily.
You tend to do well in visible, public-facing or service roles where you can share your energy. Recognition often comes, and pacing yourself keeps it sustainable.
You may thrive in finance, technical skill or roles that need decisive action. Your discipline builds results, and teamwork adds warmth to your success.
You tend to prefer pleasant workplaces and roles that serve or delight others. Steady effort helps your easy talent turn into a fulfilling career.
You may excel in roles that call for principle, precision or authority, such as law, order or exacting craft. Your focus is a strength, and openness helps teams follow you.
You tend to thrive in management, administration or roles that safeguard resources. Your reliability builds trust, and fresh ideas keep your work growing.
You may do well in refined, caring or behind-the-scenes work, such as design, planning or nurturing roles. Quiet consistency tends to build a respected career.
You tend to thrive in roles that use charm and versatility, such as creative, social or sales work. Choosing a clear focus helps your many talents add up.
You may excel in work built on words and analysis, such as teaching, law, research or consulting. Careful speech tends to turn your insight into influence.
You tend to do well in supportive, organising or mediating roles, often as a trusted right hand. Fairness and diligence build your reputation.
You may thrive in roles that protect, teach or guide, such as education, care or advisory work. Your calm wisdom tends to earn lasting respect.
You tend to thrive where courage and initiative are needed, such as leading new ventures or demanding missions. Patience with others helps your drive go further.
You may be drawn to pioneering, reforming or entrepreneurial work. Your talent for renewal opens new paths, and steady follow-through makes them last.
ziwei_stars_in_children: Your children or creative projects may show strong character and a wish to stand out. Guiding them with respect for their independence tends to bring out their best.
Your children or projects may be bright, curious and quick to change direction. Encouraging their ideas while offering gentle structure helps them flourish.
You tend to be a warm, generous presence for children and those you mentor. Your encouragement often lights their way, and letting them shine on their own is a gift too.
You may approach children and creative work with practical care and high standards. Mixing guidance with tenderness helps your support feel both firm and kind.
Your relationship with children or protégés tends to be relaxed and affectionate. Shared play and simple joys often bring you close.
You may feel deeply responsible for children or those you guide, with firm values to pass on. Leaving space for their own choices keeps the bond trusting.
You tend to provide a stable, secure base for children and creative projects. Steady care often helps what you nurture grow at its own pace.
You may nurture children and projects gently, with sensitivity to their moods. Your quiet devotion tends to leave a lasting sense of comfort.
Your children or projects may be lively, talented and full of interests. Helping them focus their gifts tends to draw out their potential.
Talks with children or mentees may be lively, full of questions and opinions. Listening patiently and explaining kindly helps understanding grow on both sides.
You tend to guide children and protégés with fairness and good manners. Your even-handed care often teaches them how to treat others well.
You may be a natural mentor to children or younger people, offering shelter and wisdom. Trusting them to learn from their own steps keeps your care light.
Your children or protégés may be independent and bold, eager to forge their own path. Giving them room while staying steady in the background tends to work well.
Your children or projects may be inventive and unconventional, bringing fresh energy. Embracing their originality while helping them finish what they start supports their growth.
ziwei_stars_in_fortune: You tend to find inner peace through purpose, dignity and a sense of contribution. Quiet confidence often deepens with the years.
Your mind is rarely still, and peace may come through learning and thoughtful reflection. Gentle practices that quiet the mind tend to bring contentment.
You tend to find joy in giving and in sharing your light with others. Allowing yourself rest and simple pleasures keeps your spirit full.
Your contentment may come through achievement and a clear purpose. Learning to rest in what you have already built brings a deeper peace.
You tend to have a naturally contented spirit and a gift for enjoying life. Simple pleasures and good company often bring you lasting happiness.
You may feel things intensely and seek meaning in your values. Inner peace tends to grow when you let go of what you cannot control.
You tend to have a calm, steady spirit and find comfort in security and order. Gratitude for what you have often brings lasting peace.
Your inner world tends to be rich, gentle and reflective. Beauty, art and quiet moments often bring you deep contentment.
You may seek joy through many experiences and pleasures. Finding a few deep sources of meaning tends to bring the most lasting fulfilment.
Your mind may often analyse and question, which can keep it busy. Practices that bring quiet and trust tend to ease your spirit.
You tend to find peace in fairness, harmony and helping others. Remembering your own needs keeps your contentment balanced.
You tend to have a resilient spirit and often feel quietly supported through life. Sharing your wisdom with others deepens your own peace.
Your spirit may be restless and driven, always seeking the next challenge. Learning to pause and appreciate the present brings deeper calm.
Your inner life may move through cycles of change and renewal. Each transformation can bring fresh meaning when you treat it as growth.
ziwei_stars_in_friends: You may have influential friends and colleagues, and you often take a central role in groups. Mutual respect tends to keep these circles strong.
Your network may be full of clever, idea-rich people, and connections shift over time. Staying in touch with a few key friends keeps support close.
You tend to give a lot to friends and colleagues, and your warmth gathers people around you. Choosing relationships that give back keeps you balanced.
Your friendships may be practical, built through work and shared goals. Reliable partners tend to support you, and clear terms keep cooperation healthy.
Your circle tends to be friendly, easygoing and supportive. Relaxed gatherings and simple kindness often bring lasting friendships.
You may choose friends carefully and value loyalty above all. A few deep, principled connections often mean more to you than many casual ones.
Your friends and colleagues tend to be steady and dependable. You often manage shared resources well, and trust grows over time.
You may have gentle, caring friends, with bonds formed quietly and over time. Small gestures of thoughtfulness tend to deepen these ties.
You tend to have a wide, lively social circle with many interests. Choosing friends who share your values helps your network support your growth.
Conversations with friends may be lively and full of debate. Clear communication and patient listening tend to keep friendships strong.
Friends and colleagues often see you as fair and helpful, and you may be the one who smooths things over. Supportive allies tend to return that care.
You may be a mentor within your circle, or have older friends who guide you. Mutual care tends to make these connections lasting.
Your friends may be independent and strong-minded, each with their own path. Respect for each other's freedom tends to keep bonds healthy.
Your social circle may change over the years, with new friends arriving as you grow. Staying open while keeping a few steady ties brings balance.
ziwei_stars_in_health: Your energy tends to be steady and composed, and you may carry a lot of responsibility. Regular rest and moments free of duty help you stay balanced.
Your energy may rise and fall with your busy mind. Calm routines, gentle movement and time away from planning tend to restore your balance.
You tend to have warm, outgoing energy and may give more than you keep. Pacing yourself and honouring rest helps your vitality stay bright.
Your constitution is often resilient and your will strong. Balancing hard work with softness, rest and enjoyable movement helps your energy last.
Your energy tends to be easy and gentle, and comfort comes naturally. Light, regular activity and mindful habits help keep you lively.
You may hold tension inside when you care deeply about something. Ways to release intensity, such as movement, breathing or creative outlets, tend to restore your calm.
Your constitution is often steady and grounded. Keeping a balanced, moderate rhythm in meals, rest and activity helps sustain that stability.
Your energy tends to be gentle and sensitive to mood and surroundings. Quiet evenings, good sleep and emotional ease often support your balance.
You may enjoy life's pleasures fully, and your energy follows your enthusiasm. Moderation and a regular rhythm help keep your vitality steady.
You may carry thoughts and worries longer than you need to. Talking things through, quiet time and calming habits tend to lighten your energy.
Your energy tends to be balanced when your surroundings feel fair and orderly. Caring for yourself as well as you care for others keeps you steady.
Your constitution is often resilient, with a calm, enduring energy. Keeping regular habits even when life gets busy helps sustain your natural steadiness.
You tend to have strong, driven energy and may push yourself hard. Pausing to recover after big efforts helps your strength stay sustainable.
Your energy may come in bursts, with intense effort followed by a need to recharge. Steady routines between bursts help you stay balanced through change.
ziwei_stars_in_life: You tend to carry yourself with quiet dignity and a natural sense of responsibility. Others often look to you for direction, and you grow most when you lead with openness rather than control.
Your mind is quick and inventive, always mapping the next step. You may change plans often, and you tend to thrive in roles that reward thoughtful strategy and good advice.
You tend to be open, warm and generous, with a bright presence others notice. Giving comes easily to you; remembering to rest and receive keeps your light steady.
You are often decisive, practical and determined, with a clear sense of what is worth the effort. Your resolve builds real results, and a gentler tone helps others feel your care.
You tend to be easygoing, kind and good at enjoying simple things. Life often flows gently around you, and a little steady discipline helps your gifts come fully into view.
You hold yourself to firm principles and feel things deeply, even when you show little on the surface. Your focus is strong, and flexibility helps your integrity feel warm rather than rigid.
You tend to be steady, prudent and quietly capable, someone who keeps things safe and in order. People trust your judgement, and openness to change keeps your stability fresh.
You are often gentle, refined and inward-looking, with a rich emotional life. You tend to nurture others and save for the future, and sharing your feelings helps your quiet strength show.
You tend to be charming, versatile and curious, with many interests and a gift for connecting. Focusing your talents on a few true passions lets your appeal turn into lasting achievement.
You think carefully and speak with conviction, often seeing what others miss. Your questions sharpen any discussion, and warmth in how you say things helps your insight be welcomed.
You tend to be fair, courteous and helpful, with a natural eye for balance and good presentation. Others value your support, and standing up for your own wishes keeps that support healthy.
